indicator_name: Goods exports by commodity group (HS prefixes), thousand USD, monthly
description: Экспорт товаров по товарным группам (ТН ВЭД), тыс. долларов США, помесячно
methodology: TOTAL is the published national row; the groups are sums of 6-digit HS lines over the regional blocks. Gas condensate and the 10-digit 'основные товары' subsets (petroleum products) cannot be separated at 6 digits — CRUDE_OIL is all of 2709, PETROLEUM_PRODUCTS all of 2710. Raw file: bns_exports_2026-09-18.xlsx.
